name: io.github.manasdutta04/otter
title: Otter
description: Repository brain: impact, architecture guard, verify, and approval-gated tasks for AI coding agents.

environmentVariables.name: OTTER_REPO_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the repository checkout Otter should analyze

environmentVariables.name: OTTER_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Otter API base URL for memory and code-tasks (default http://127.0.0.1:8000)

environmentVariables.name: OTTER_SESSION
environmentVariables.description: Web/Docker otter_session cookie for API persistence (not CLI GitHub login)

environmentVariables.name: OTTER_REPOSITORY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Imported repository id under REPOSITORY_DATA_DIR when not using OTTER_REPO_ROOT alone
